decisions.reason: As a 2023 line still shown on its own page in 2024 and close to the core range, it looks like a low-cost option with enough acceptance to keep in the portfolio.
This 2023 ceiling luminaire remained fully presented in 2024, so for a design-led lighting firm in a growing market it is sensible to keep exploiting the option rather than exit early.
Because it was launched only in 2024 and sits near the established offer, uncertainty is still resolving and the firm would usually keep such a recent option open.
As a complementary canopy product building on existing systems, it likely has modest carrying costs and supports the broader modular offer, which favors retention.
This low-voltage canopy extends the established system architecture, so the firm is likely to keep it on the market while learning about demand at relatively low risk.
Its weaker website presence suggests a less committed or more experimental launch, but as a very recent line close to the firm's design-oriented core it is still more likely to be kept than dropped.
